caption:
Negative doesn't mean extraneous.

Graph y = √(x + 10) − x and y = 4 in Desmos. Find the crossing, then check it: a negative solution can still be real.

Comment your answer before you check.
tiktok_caption: A negative answer can be the real one. Graph both sides to check.

youtube.title: Negative Doesn't Mean Extraneous: Radical Equation Check
